title: A Hollow for the Salt
premise: Sebastian Okonkwo, an exiled storm-caller hiding as a charm-seller in the magic-free city of Greyharbor, discovers that the crown's new witch-hunt is a cover for harvesting gifted blood to wake the Salt King, an ancient power buried beneath the sea. When Sebastian rescues a hunted child, Wren, whose blood is the final key, they become fugitives alongside a disgraced inquisitor, Maren, who must choose between her oath and the truth. As the hunt closes in, Sebastian learns their own exile was engineered to keep them from the Salt King's resting place, and that waking or binding it will cost a life freely given. In the end, Sebastian offers themselves to the deep, but Wren's found family refuses the sacrifice, binding the Salt King with shared grief instead of a single death — and the three of them walk out of the flood together, outlaws no longer needed by any law but their own.
about_author: Vesper Kavanagh is the pen name of a former maritime archivist who spent a decade cataloguing drowned coastal towns before turning to fiction. They write storm-soaked fantasy about people the law forgot, and live somewhere within earshot of the Atlantic.

chapters.title: Charms for a Rainless City
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. A day in Greyharbor: selling luck-knots and weather-bones to dockworkers while hiding the storm coiled under their skin. A child, Wren, steals a charm and Sebastian lets them go. Emotional beat: loneliness disguised as contentment, cracked open by one small act of kindness.

chapters.title: The Proclamation
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Criers announce the Gifted Purge: registration, then the hunt. Sebastian burns twenty years of careful anonymity in one night of preparation. Emotional beat: dread sharpening into resolve; the past refusing to stay buried.

chapters.title: What the Tide Brought In
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. The street kid witnesses soldiers dragging a gift-marked fisherman away and flees to the only adult who was ever kind. Emotional beat: terror transformed into stubborn loyalty; Wren chooses Sebastian without knowing what it costs.

chapters.title: Maren Vale, Inquisitor
chapters.summary: Maren's POV. Introduced leading the purge's first sweep, efficient and hollow. She finds a lead on 'the charm-seller' but hesitates over evidence that doesn't fit. Emotional beat: duty beginning to itch like a wound she can't stop touching.

chapters.title: The Cellar Beneath the Chapel
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Hiding Wren in an abandoned smugglers' chapel, Sebastian reveals magic for the first time in two decades — a small, warm light. Emotional beat: wonder after long starvation; found family taking its first breath.

chapters.title: Salt in the Archives
chapters.summary: Maren's POV. Researching purge orders, Maren finds the harvested gifted aren't imprisoned — they're shipped to the drowned fortress of Karstholm. Her report is rewritten above her signature. Emotional beat: betrayal; the law revealing itself as something else entirely.

chapters.title: A Bargain at Knifepoint
chapters.summary: Sebastian and Maren's POV alternating. Maren corners Sebastian in the chapel; instead of arresting them, she asks what Karstholm really is. Uneasy truce struck. Emotional beat: two enemies discovering they share a truer enemy than each other.

chapters.title: The Road Out of Greyharbor
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Flight along the coast road with Wren and Maren; a checkpoint nearly ends everything until Maren uses her inquisitor's seal one last time. Emotional beat: fragile trust tested by fire; the trio becoming a unit.

chapters.title: Storm Lessons
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. On the road, Sebastian teaches Wren to sense the gift stirring in them too. First lightning answers Wren's hand. Emotional beat: inheritance and fear; joy tangled with the knowledge that the gift is now a death sentence.

chapters.title: Karstholm Rising
chapters.summary: Maren's POV. From cliffs, they watch ships unload captives into the drowned fortress, and see the sea around it glowing wrong. Maren confesses her part in earlier purges. Emotional beat: guilt laid bare; forgiveness neither granted nor refused.

chapters.title: The Drowned Fortress
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Infiltration through flooded tunnels using storm-calling to breathe and bend water. They find cells full of the taken, alive but drained. Emotional beat: horror and purpose fused; rescue becomes war.

chapters.title: Wren's Blood
chapters.summary: Maren's POV. Captured records reveal the Salt King wakes when royal blood mingles with the oldest gift — and Wren's lineage marks them as the key. Emotional beat: protective fury; the secret becomes a burden too heavy for one carrier.

chapters.title: Twenty Years of Exile, Explained
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. An old prisoner recognizes Sebastian: their exile was arranged by the last storm-caller council to keep them far from Karstholm, because Sebastian's line can bind the King — or crown it. Emotional beat: identity shattered and rebuilt; exile reframed as protection.

chapters.title: The Hunt Closes
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. The purge commander, Lord Aldery, corners them in the fortress; prisoners rise in chaos. Escape through collapsing tunnels with freed captives. Emotional beat: desperate momentum; justice seized outside any courtroom.

chapters.title: Refuge at the Saltmarsh
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. The fugitives shelter in a marsh village of hidden gifted — a community that has survived outside the law for generations. Wren almost belongs somewhere. Emotional beat: found family widening; hope that feels dangerous to hold.

chapters.title: What Maren Owes
chapters.summary: Maren's POV. Aldery offers Maren full pardon to deliver Wren. She burns the offer in front of him and becomes a true outlaw. Emotional beat: the cost of conscience paid in full; duty finally turned inside out.

chapters.title: The Binding Rite
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. The marsh elders teach the old rite: the Salt King can be bound only by a life freely given. Sebastian prepares to go alone, lying to Wren and Maren about it. Emotional beat: love against duty at its sharpest; sacrifice dressed as secrecy.

chapters.title: The Lie Unraveled
chapters.summary: Wren's POV. Wren discovers Sebastian's plan and refuses to let them go alone; Maren catches them both leaving and joins anyway. Emotional beat: anger as devotion; the family refusing to let one member pay for all.

chapters.title: Karstholm, Second Descent
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Battle through the awakened fortress as the Salt King stirs — a vast hunger wearing the shapes of the drowned. Aldery falls to his own harvest. Emotional beat: climax begins; awe and terror at ancient scale.

chapters.title: The Offering Refused
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. At the King's heart, Sebastian steps into the deep — but Wren and Maren seize the rite and pour their shared grief into it alongside Sebastian, splitting the cost three ways. The King binds not to one death but to a bond it cannot consume. Emotional beat: climax resolved by connection defeating sacrifice.

chapters.title: After the Flood
chapters.summary: Maren's POV. The waters recede; the freed gifted and the marsh folk emerge into a kingdom whose purge has collapsed with Aldery. Maren surrenders her seal publicly and is sentenced to nothing anyone can enforce. Emotional beat: exhaustion, grief for the lost, and the strange lightness of survival.

chapters.title: A Hollow Filled
chapters.summary: Sebastian's POV. Months later: a small shop in the marsh village, charms sold openly, Wren learning storms, Maren fixing the roof. Sebastian calls real rain over dry fields at last. Emotional beat: resolution; the hollow made by exile finally filled by chosen family.
